capabilities: Uploads pasted or dropped images to a public GitHub repository
Inserts raw.githubusercontent.com links without creating local attachments
Connects via GitHub App browser login or a personal access token
Converts HEIC and HEIF images to JPEG locally before upload
Saves the image to the vault when an upload fails, if enabled
extras: Warnings: repository must be public so uploads are publicly accessible; PATs stay unencrypted in plugin data.json; browser login depends on a hosted auth relay with Cloudflare Free-plan limits, and only trusted relays should be used.
problem: Obsidian stores pasted images as local attachments in the vault; this plugin keeps them out of the vault by hosting them on GitHub.

relations.evidence: Upload pasted or dropped images to your public GitHub repository and embed their URLs in Obsidian.

requires.name: GitHub account with a public image repository
GitHub personal access token (only in PAT mode)

summary: Uploads pasted or dropped images to a public GitHub repository and inserts the raw CDN link instead of saving them locally.
